Several Codex entries through ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically "Alien Initiatives", "Executor [[Krannus]]", and "Commander [[Vergost]]", as well as the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'', establish that prior to the [[Battle of Ilum]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] is exceedingly [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]], and the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] was composed almost entirely of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith purebloods]]. It is only in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', after the [[Dark Council]] acknowledges that [[Darth Malgus]]'s alliances with [[Alien/Legends|alien]] cultures would benefit the Empire, that aliens are permitted to become [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in the Imperial Military.<noinclude>
